title: Portable evaluator build probe preparation
problem: The pinned SDK lacks portable valid build-probe preparation and the served-catalog authority prerequisite required by the merged upstream fix.
localBehavior: Patch only reviewed SDK14.0.0-rc.53 CJS/ESM loader, runner, schema-authority and declaration preimages; add portable creative-build preparation plus the SDK15.9.5 served-catalog authority prerequisite without changing request pins or accounting. This is testing-only integration; the general TaskExecutor remains the original SDK14 pin-only implementation. The ledgered authority regression uses private validators for cache-identity assertions and compares the installed runtime with an owned temporary copy reconstructed by exact reverse hashes; it never writes the installed package.
removalCondition: Remove after the upstream creative-build-probe runner fix is merged, available in a qualified SDK release, and both full and standalone regression suites pass after upgrading the pinned dependency. Do not release the SDK from this task.
